title: Prepared portable Wellbeing pilot and developer handoff
summary: Created a self-contained host bootstrap, four responsibility definitions, seven skills, role/task/report contracts and local reference runtime grounded in the current design.
outcome: 66 local automated tests and 37 synthetic CLI commands passed. Public package includes source traceability and an explicitly model-based protocol review. Real vendor-host execution remains a participant pilot activity.
decisions: Host assistant is Chief of Staff outside Manager, Analyst and Coach.
Use native roles only with observed capabilities; otherwise disclose virtual roles.
Keep per-participant consent, evidence, task reports and retention outside the public checkout.
Internal manager review is distinct from report receipt, task closure, human delivery and observed outcome.
next_actions: Run the portable entrypoint in the participant's actual host and record observed capabilities and feedback.
Implement and verify production adapters only within a concrete authorized environment.
